name: vitals
description: A live vitals band above the prompt, in the terminal and in the desktop app: model and reasoning effort, context meter, 5-hour and weekly plan limits with reset countdowns, session cost, and per-turn and per-session tokens in/out, cache read/write and hit rate. /vitals switches between the full band and one compact line.

cache_ttl.title: Prompt-cache TTL
cache_ttl.description: How long the main conversation's prompt cache lives: 1h or 5m (anything else counts as 1h). The band marks the cache cold after this much idle time. 1h on a Claude subscription within plan usage; 5m with API billing, a cloud provider or usage credits.
